name: Quickchange Studded Leather
body:
Price 14,275 gp; Slot armor; CL 5th; Weight 7 lbs.; Aura faint transmutation

DESCRIPTION

Putting on this suit of +2 studded leather is pure ease and comfort. With the merest of effort, the armor conforms itself to the wearer by adjusting itself to the wearer’s limbs, pulling its own straps, fastening its own buckles, and cinching itself for effortless fit. Likewise, when it’s time to remove the armor, it all but jumps off the wearer. By speaking a command word, the straps loosen, knots unravel, and the entire suit comes sliding off.

A suit of quickchange studded leather reduces the amount of time to don the armor to 5 rounds and only 1 round to don hastily. With a command word, removing the armor is 1 move action. The wearer may choose to remove a suit of quickchange studded leather as part of making an Escape Artist check. This does not require a separate action and grants the wearer a +10 circumstance bonus on a single Escape Artist check to escape bonds, a grapple, or a trap.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 7,225 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells grease
